id: title:Gilbert09:treat federated jdbc connection failures as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies warehouse ingestion behavior for Databricks Lakehouse Federation JDBC failures, distinguishing permanent connection errors from transient ones to prevent unnecessary retry loops.
review.reason: Adds a permanent, non-retryable error classification for Databricks JDBC connection failures and a corresponding test assertion. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness improvement: it prevents PostHog from wasting resources retrying unrecoverable database connections while retaining existing retry behavior for transient errors. review.uncertainty: The actual runtime behavior and complete implementation of the warehouse ingestion and retry mechanisms are not fully visible in this hunk; the benefit relies on the surrounding system correctly interpreting this new error classification. No evidence of actual production incidents or adoption is provided.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new permanent, non-retryable error classification for Databricks Lakehouse Federation JDBC connection failures.
observations.code_quote: "[FAILED_JDBC.CONNECTION]": "Databricks couldn't connect to a federated database backing a table you're syncing (a Lakehouse Federation connection). Check that the underlying database is reachable and its connection details in Databricks are still correct, then resync.",
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies PostHog warehouse ingestion behavior: distinguishes between transient and permanent failures, preventing unnecessary retry loops for JDBC connectivity issues that PostHog cannot resolve. This could reduce ingestion latency and avoid resource waste on unrecoverable connection errors.

observations.behavior: Adds a corresponding test assertion for the new JDBC connection failure error message.
observations.code_quote: "[FAILED_JDBC.CONNECTION] Failed JDBC jdbc:postgresql://db.example.com:5432/mydb on the operation: Failed to connect to the database. SQLSTATE: HV000",
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the new error classification, ensuring PostHog correctly identifies and treats this specific JDBC failure as a permanent, non-retryable condition.
